items.title: BrainJanus: A Unified Model for Understanding and Generation across Brain, Vision, and Language
items.summary: BrainJanus represents the first unified brain model integrating brain, vision, and language through a shared Omni space, enabling bidirectional mapping between neural activity and sensory stimuli via a tokenized representation and autoregressive architecture.

items.title: Unlocking the Visual Record of Materials Science: A Large-Scale Multimodal Dataset from Scientific Literature
items.summary: A novel pipeline called MatMMExtract is introduced that processes compound scientific figures into individual panels and generates structured annotations using large language models, creating a comprehensive dataset for vision-language learning in materials science.

items.title: FlexiSLM: A Dynamic and Controllable Frame Rate Spoken Language Model
items.summary: Flexible Spoken Language Model (FlexiSLM) introduces dynamic frame rate capabilities for speech input and output, achieving superior performance over fixed-frame-rate models while enabling controllable inference speed.

items.title: Scenes as Objects, Not Primitives: Instance-Structured 3D Tokenization from Unposed Views
items.summary: A feed-forward framework decomposes 3D scenes into instance-structured token groups from multi-view images, enabling direct object-level reconstruction, segmentation, and manipulation without 3D annotations.

items.title: Evolution Fine-Tuning: Learning to Discover Across 371 Optimization Tasks
items.summary: Evolutionary fine-tuning enables large language models to develop cross-task problem-solving capabilities by learning from search trajectories, demonstrating improved performance on mathematical conjectures and optimization tasks.

items.title: LUMOS: A Semantic Operating-System Layer for Accessibility-Grounded AI Agents
items.summary: LUMOS provides a semantic interaction layer that converts operating system metadata into machine-readable formats, enabling AI agents to interact more efficiently with computer interfaces than through traditional visual methods.

items.title: SWE-Together: Evaluating Coding Agents in Interactive User Sessions
items.summary: SWE-Together is a multi-turn coding benchmark created from real user-agent interactions, featuring a reactive LLM simulator to evaluate agents based on both final correctness and interaction efficiency.

items.title: RocketSmith: Agentic Additive Manufacturing of High-Powered Rockets
items.summary: An agentic system using large language models automates high-power rocket design processes, enabling successful flight testing with consistent simulation results.

items.title: A Gravitational Interpretation of Fine-Tuning Reversion
items.summary: Post-alignment safety degradation arises from geometric properties of training history, where fine-tuning reversion follows a persistent direction defined by early training dynamics.

items.title: Beyond Drug Discovery: The Nanotechnology Molecular Optimization (NMO) Benchmark
items.summary: The Nanotechnology Molecular Optimization (NMO) Benchmark introduces physics-based molecular design challenges that require new generative model approaches, moving beyond drug-discovery-focused metrics to enable scientific discovery in nanotechnology.

items.title: TheoremGraph: Bridging Formal and Informal Mathematics
items.summary: A unified mathematical dependency graph connects informal and formal mathematics through semantic embedding and automated extraction from arXiv papers and Lean projects.

items.title: Learning Transferable Dynamics Priors from Action to World Modeling
items.summary: Action-conditioned world modeling enables transferable dynamics priors for robot learning through pretraining on large-scale manipulation data, supporting both simulator-based policy evaluation and video-action prediction.

items.title: QVal: Cheaply Evaluating Dense Supervision Signals for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
items.summary: A testbed called QVal is introduced for evaluating dense supervision signals in long-horizon LLM agent tasks by measuring how well method scores align with Q-values, enabling fair comparison of different supervision approaches without training.

items.title: Managing Procedural Memory in LLM Agents: Control, Adaptation, and Evaluation
items.summary: Procedural memory enhances LLM agents on workplace tasks through skill transfer across roles and models, with varying generalization capabilities affecting deployment strategies.

items.title: DataEvolver: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Data Construction for Text-Rich Image Generation
items.summary: DataEvolver is a self-evolving multi-agent framework that improves text-rich image generation by leveraging feedback from rejected samples to iteratively enhance data quality.

items.title: RedVox: Safety and Fairness Gaps in Speech Models Across Languages
items.summary: Multilingual safety and fairness benchmark for speech models reveals persistent vulnerabilities across languages and naturalistic conditions.

items.title: GEAR: Guided End-to-End AutoRegression for Image Synthesis
items.summary: GEAR trains a vector-quantized tokenizer and autoregressive generator jointly end-to-end using representation alignment, overcoming non-differentiability issues through a dual read-out approach that improves convergence speed and feature quality.

items.title: Multi-Block Diffusion Language Models
items.summary: Multi-Block Diffusion Language Models extend single-block diffusion to concurrent block decoding with improved training strategies and optimized decoding algorithms.

items.title: Reinforcement Learning with Metacognitive Feedback Elicits Faithful Uncertainty Expression in LLMs
items.summary: Reinforcement learning with metacognitive feedback and metacognitive data selection improve large language model calibration by enabling accurate self-assessment of performance and uncertainty.

items.title: TerraDiT-Ω: Unified Spatial Control for Satellite Image Synthesis with Any Geospatial Primitive
items.summary: TerraDiT-Ω generates satellite imagery from native geospatial primitives using Geometry-Aware Local Attention, enabling flexible conditioning and improved downstream geospatial tasks.

items.title: Xiaomi-GUI-0 Technical Report
items.summary: A native multimodal GUI agent trained in real-device environments demonstrates superior performance and stability compared to traditional benchmark-based approaches.

items.title: MemLearner: Learning to Query Context memory for Video World Models
items.summary: MemLearner improves video world models by using learning-based adaptive context querying with query tokens to enhance scene consistency and memory in long video sequences with occlusions and dynamic objects.

items.title: Orca: The World is in Your Mind
items.summary: Orca establishes a unified world latent space through next-state-prediction modeling using multimodal data and demonstrates superior performance in downstream tasks compared to specialized baselines.

items.title: AVTok: 1D Unified Tokenization for Holistic Audio-Video Generation
items.summary: AVTok is a unified tokenizer for audio-video generation that uses a dual-stream transformer architecture with shared encoder-decoder and modal-specific queries to create compact one-dimensional latent representations.

items.title: Dockerless: Environment-Free Program Verifier for Coding Agents
items.summary: A Dockerless environment-free agentic patch verifier improves code patch evaluation accuracy and enables effective post-training without execution-based verification costs.

items.title: Drop-Then-Recovery: How Redundant Are Vision-Language-Action Models?
items.summary: Research reveals that language backbones in Vision-Language-Action models are highly redundant for robotic manipulation tasks, while vision and action pathways are more critical, suggesting need for deliberate capacity allocation in future architectures.

items.title: LLM Program Optimization via Retrieval Augmented Search
items.summary: Blackbox adaptation methods using retrieval-augmented search and atomic edit decomposition improve program optimization performance for both C++ and Python code.

items.title: Mind the Heads: Topological Representation Alignment for Multimodal LLMs
items.summary: HeRA aligns individual attention heads in MLLMs to preserve local neighborhood relationships across modalities, improving vision-centric task performance and reducing visual hallucinations.

items.title: One-Step Gradient Delay is Not a Barrier for Large-Scale Asynchronous Pipeline Parallel LLM Pretraining
items.summary: Asynchronous pipeline parallelism with PipeDream-2BW can achieve near-synchronous performance through optimizer selection and error feedback correction, overcoming traditional stability concerns.

items.title: One Scene, Two Depths: Probing Geometric Ambiguity in Monocular Foundation Models
items.summary: A faithful 3D world representation should account for layered geometry, where a single camera ray may contain multiple visible and geometrically valid surfaces. Monocular depth estimation, however, reduces this structure to one scalar depth per pixel. Transparent scenes make this ambiguity measurable: the same ray can pass through foreground glass and observe the background, turning the supervised target into a convention of annotation, data, and training rather than a scene-intrinsic truth. A learned predictor exposes this convention as its depth-layer preference. We introduce MultiDepth-3k (MD-3k), a sparse two-layer ordinal benchmark for measuring depth-layer preference and multi-layer spatial relationship accuracy (ML-SRA). On MD-3k, leading depth foundation models exhibit diverse layer preferences under standard RGB input, showing that the same layered geometry can be resolved differently across models. We further find that Laplacian Visual Prompting (LVP), a training-free spectral input transformation, can substantially change the reported layer for certain frozen models. The strongest RGB/LVP pair, DAv2-L, reaches 75.5% ML-SRA. These results suggest that depth foundation models may express complementary geometric hypotheses that standard RGB inference leaves unexpressed. We invite the community to rethink depth supervision and evaluation through an ambiguity-aware lens, where multiple valid 3D interpretations are treated as geometric structure to be measured, preserved, and expressed.

items.title: Illuminating Unified Multimodal Model for Free-form Interleaved Text-Image Generation
items.summary: ILLUME-X is a unified multimodal paradigm that enhances text-image generation through improved data efficiency, stable training processes, and comprehensive evaluation metrics.

items.title: Beyond IID: How General Are Tabular Foundation Models, Really?
items.summary: Tabular foundation models show varying performance across different data conditions, with traditional methods still outperforming newer approaches on complex, large-scale datasets.

items.title: Agentic Abstention: Do Agents Know When to Stop Instead of Act?
items.summary: Agentic abstention involves determining when an AI agent should cease interaction under uncertainty, requiring sequential decision-making across multiple environments and task types.

items.title: Large-Scale Tunnel Air-Ground Collaboration With FLISP: Fast LiDAR-IMU Synchronized Path Planner
items.summary: Hydropower tunnel inspection is critical for infrastructure integrity yet remains inefficient and hazardous using manual methods. We propose FLISP (Fast LiDAR-IMU Synchronized Path Planner), a mapless planning framework for cooperative UGV-UAV inspection. Unlike traditional map-based paradigms, FLISP features three core contributions: (1) a unified architecture where a single UGV-mounted LiDAR-IMU suite drives synchronized path generation for both platforms; (2) platform-specific solvers utilizing an enhanced Firefly Algorithm for UGV obstacle avoidance and a dynamic iterative optimizer for UAV flight; and (3) a hierarchical refinement strategy ensuring kinematic feasibility without state estimation drift. Benchmarks in a 1.2 km operational tunnel demonstrate that FLISP circumvents structural bottlenecks of map-based methods, eliminating map rasterization overhead (Fast-LIO2 + A*) and sampling instability (LIO-SAM + RRT*). FLISP achieves a 100% success rate with 7 ms latency, representing a 7-fold speedup over grid-based and a three-order-of-magnitude improvement over sampling-based baselines. Validated in operational hydropower tunnels, this approach offers a scalable solution for robotic inspection in feature-degraded linear infrastructure. A demonstration video is available at https://youtu.be/Y_ezs1PfLJ4, and the code at https://github.com/ArchibaldGuo/FLISP.git.

items.title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Video Diffusion Models for Hand Motion Reconstruction
items.summary: ViDiHand uses pretrained video diffusion model representations with hand-overlay rendering to reconstruct 4D hand motion directly from video frames without detectors or optimization.

items.title: Interleaved Speech Language Models Latently Work In Text
items.summary: Interleaved speech-text language models exhibit an implicit transcription phase where text tokens become decodable in intermediate layers, followed by text-based prediction before speech domain transformation.

items.title: SkillHone: A Harness for Continual Agent Skill Evolution Through Persistent Decision History
items.summary: SkillHone enables continuous evolution of agent skills by maintaining persistent decision histories and incorporating practice feedback for improved performance across research and tool-mediated analysis tasks.

items.title: MuSViT: A Foundation Vision Model for Sheet Music Representation
items.summary: MuSViT is a vision transformer-based foundation model pre-trained on millions of sheet music pages that demonstrates superior performance in music score recognition and symbol detection tasks through both linear probing and fine-tuning approaches.

items.title: Little Brains, Big Feats: Exploring Compact Language Models
items.summary: Small language models can effectively perform retrieval-augmented generation tasks directly on-device without GPU acceleration.

items.title: PhotoQuilt: Training-Free Arbitrary-Resolution Photomosaics via Bootstrapped Tiled Denoising
items.summary: PhotoQuilt is a training-free framework that generates high-resolution photomosaics by combining global layout composition with separate tile generation in latent space, overcoming limitations of diffusion models in balancing local detail and global structure.

items.title: BlockPilot: Instance-Adaptive Policy Learning for Diffusion-based Speculative Decoding
items.summary: Speculative decoding with adaptive block size selection improves inference efficiency by predicting optimal block sizes from prefilling representations, achieving significant speedup with minimal overhead.

items.title: PolyFlow: Continuous Topology Embedding Flow Matching for Artist-style Mesh Generation
items.summary: PolyFlow introduces a continuous mesh representation using a topology embedder and applies flow-matching with Transformers for parallel mesh generation, achieving faster inference and precise resolution control compared to autoregressive methods.

items.title: DOPD: Dual On-policy Distillation
items.summary: DOPD addresses privilege illusion in on-policy distillation by dynamically routing token-level supervision between teacher and student policies based on advantage gaps and probabilities, improving capability transfer in large and vision-language models.

items.title: Delayed Verification Destabilizes Multi-Agent LLM Belief: Instability Thresholds and Optimal Corrector Placement
items.summary: Delayed verification in multi-agent LLM systems can cause instability leading to oscillations, but grounded factual answering stabilizes the system by making truth an absorbing boundary.

items.title: One Model, Many Latencies: Universal Speech Enhancement for Diverse Real-Time Applications
items.summary: A universal speech enhancement model with configurable algorithmic and computational latency controls using parallel convolutions and early-exit mechanisms.

items.title: SAM2Matting: Generalized Image and Video Matting
items.summary: SAM2Matting advances video matting by decoupling tracking and matting tasks through a tracker-to-matting framework that leverages foundational trackers with region-proposal bridges and dedicated matting heads.

items.title: RaysUp: Ultra-light Universal Feature Upsampling via Geometry-Aware Ray Representation
items.summary: RaysUp is a lightweight, task-agnostic feature upsampling framework that reconstructs high-resolution features using geometry-aware ray domain techniques with improved efficiency and accuracy.

items.title: How Good Can Linear Models Be for Time-Series Forecasting?
items.summary: Research demonstrates that preprocessing optimizations, particularly in context length, normalization, and regularization, can significantly improve time-series forecasting accuracy more effectively than scaling model architectures.

items.title: ZooClaw-FashionSigLIP2: Distilled Fine-tuning for Robust Fashion Retrieval
items.summary: A fashion-specialized vision-language model achieves superior retrieval performance through full fine-tuning with knowledge distillation and weight interpolation, outperforming existing methods on a new benchmark while addressing structural biases in existing datasets.

items.title: MirrorPPR: Exemplar-Based Portrait Photo Retouching
items.summary: Exemplar-based portrait retouching framework using Diffusion Transformer with LoRA adaptation and self-augmented training data achieves superior quality and identity preservation.
